column1: # Hardware-gate register (DRA-19): the one source for every gate status. docs/HARDWARE_GATES.md explains it.
# Fields (tab-separated): id  component  source  tier  status  receipt  owner/blocker
# tier: HOST | QEMU | PHYSICAL. status: PASS | FAIL | NOT_RUN | BLOCKED_HARDWARE | BLOCKED_OPERATOR | MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION
# PASS/FAIL need a receipt under evidence/ holding the line "HWGATE <id> <tier> <status>"; other statuses use receipt "-".
# Every id has exactly one PHYSICAL row, and a gate a receipt names keeps its rows. Checked by tools/hwgates/hwgates.om (gate AIENOS-HW-GATES).

# tools/hwgates/gate.sh also checks: the id set equals that of hardware-gates-needs.tsv; every HWGATE line in a tracked evidence file agrees with the row for its id and tier unless a tracked CORRECTION-*.txt beside it names the line; a PASS/FAIL row's source REPO@COMMIT is recorded in its receipt's folder (see the gate.sh comments).
